names.S01: A valid incoming message is accepted and linked to a customer conversation
names.S02: Messages with an invalid token or another account's token are rejected
names.S03: Oversized and future-dated messages are rejected
names.S04: A repeated message is recognized; a changed repeat is flagged as a conflict
names.S05: Messages in one conversation receive distinct, ordered sequence numbers
names.S06: A STOP reply opts the customer out and cancels pending sends, follow-ups, and hand-offs
names.S07: A request for a human creates a hand-off in the sales queue with a response deadline
names.S08: The conversation turn after a human request routes to the hand-off instead of replying
names.S09: A reply made stale by a newer customer message is not sent
names.S10: Hand-off notifications retry, reject stale claims, and stop once acknowledged
names.S11: A reply is drafted only after consent, with its sources recorded
names.S12: A reply the active model may not make goes to a human instead
names.S13: A reply containing an unsupported claim is blocked before sending
names.S14: Only one worker at a time can claim a reply for sending
names.S15: Retryable sends back off, and an uncertain send is flagged for reconciliation
names.S16: Delivery updates apply in time order, and malformed updates are rejected
names.S17: Due follow-ups are scheduled for every eligible account
names.S18: No reply is created when consent is missing
names.S19: A due follow-up is sent through the normal send path
names.S20: Only the current same-account claim can finish a send
names.S21: Deleting a customer erases their personal data from messages and delivery records
names.S22: Audit and delivery evidence cannot be edited or deleted
names.S23: The emergency stop blocks sending, including work already claimed
names.S24: A conversation stuck mid-processing is recovered and answered
names.S25: A send that has used every retry is not attempted again
names.S26: Releases rotate with recorded history and stay isolated per account
